Heart valve surgery costs differ by procedure type, valve, country, and over time. In the U.S., average aggregate 6‑month inpatient costs are about $59,743 for surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) and $64,395 for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) [d4]. Typical costs for isolated mitral procedures average roughly $30,720 for repair and are reported for replacement as well [d5], and unadjusted inpatient totals are about $60,063 for TAVR versus $60,319 for SAVR [d7]. A 2020 study estimated average aortic valve replacement at about $59,000 [d2], while 2021 U.S. averages reached $170,000, contrasted with about $20,000 in Colombia and $22,500 in Mexico [d6]. Device costs alone can range from roughly $5,000–$10,000, with transcatheter valves over $25,000 [d8]. Costs also include hospital and surgeon fees, medications, and follow‑up care [d1], and vary by age, comorbidities, and complications in post‑intervention years [d9].
